issues.description: image.tobytes() declares format='RGB' without converting PIL image, corrupting non-RGB outputs
issues.detail: Gemini may return PNG/JPEG that PIL opens as RGBA, P, or L. Calling tobytes() then declaring format='RGB' produces a buffer whose byte count and channel order do not match the declared format, violating the frame contract. Fix: call image.convert('RGB') before tobytes().

issues.description: Module-import-time monkey-patch of private genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE is a process-wide side effect
issues.detail: Mutating a third-party library's private underscore attribute at import time affects every consumer of google-genai in the process. Labeled 'temporary hack' with no exit condition, version guard, or stable contract. Push to client construction time or upstream a fix.

issues.description: Model-capability dispatch via substring checks on model name is fragile
issues.detail: Both 'image' in self._model_name and startswith('gemini-2.5-flash') encode capability as coincidence of vendor naming. Future names like 'imagen' or 'gemini-vision-image' will silently misroute thinking-budget logic. Replace with an explicit capability table keyed by model id.

issues.description: Default model silently changed from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash
issues.detail: Every caller relying on the default now sees different latency, cost, and thinking-budget behavior. CHANGELOG notes it but the constructor offers no deprecation warning, and the shift is smuggled into an unrelated feature PR. Ship as its own change with a deprecation path.

issues.description: No size bound or error handling on inline image data; OOM and decoder errors reachable
issues.detail: part.inline_data.data is fed unconditionally to BytesIO and PIL with no upper size bound, format validation, or exception handling. Oversized or malformed payloads raise PIL.UnidentifiedImageError or exhaust memory inside _process_context. Add explicit bounds and a failure path.

issues.description: No unit test covers the new image-emission branch
issues.detail: The new elif handling inline_data has neither a test nor a stated invariant. A small test feeding a synthetic inline_data part and asserting an OutputImageRawFrame with correct size/mode would have caught the RGB conversion bug. Add one focused test for the branch.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the PR is small but under-reasoned in two substantive ways. First, the new inline_data image-emission branch declares format='RGB' while passing PIL's raw bytes in whatever mode the source used, silently corrupting RGBA/P/L outputs; an explicit image.convert('RGB') is required. Second, an import-time monkey-patch of google-genai's private READ_BUFFER_SIZE is a process-wide side effect labeled as a hack with no exit condition. Secondary concerns: substring-based model-capability detection, a silent default-model bump smuggled in with an unrelated feature, and no size bounds or error handling on inline image bytes. Recommendation: do not merge until the format contract, the monkey-patch scope, and the model-capability predicate are made explicit.
